annotations.title: Getting here: fares, ferries, and whether the road is moving

description: How to reach the East End and move around it: Hampton Jitney, the LIRR Cannonball and off-peak Montauk Branch, Blade, seaplanes, the three ferries, cycling, ride-hail, and driving, each with the operator's published fare, season and stop list and the date the guide last read it. Fares are as published, including the prepaid versus on-board Jitney difference and Cross Sound's fuel surcharge. `roadConditionsNow` reports whether this instant falls inside one of the published NY-27 crawl windows, computed against the East End's clock (America/New_York), with the next window's start time and all three published windows with their days and hours; it is the published pattern, not a live incident feed. With `to`, the answer also reports which Jitney stops serve that destination and the drive-time row for that run, with typical and summer minutes. Every figure carries its source; where `sourceCaveat` appears, the record is filed against a link that does not publish the figure and the figure is the guide's own. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

mode.description: 'car-free' drops driving; 'driving' returns road answers only. Omit for every option.

to.description: The destination, a hamlet ('Montauk', 'Sag Harbor') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words. Omit for the whole picture.
